understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by activating each goal cell. A goal activates only when the carried piece matches its required shape, color, and rotation, then the player must step onto that goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Completing all goals advances the level; losing all lives ends the game.
